senses.gloss: (h. אָלַף , √לף to join, be joined) to become used; to learn, study, train one’s self.—אֲלִיף accustomed, used to.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 17:39">Targ. I Sam. XVII, 39</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 5:1">Targ. Deut. V, 1</cite>; a. fr. (v. also <cite ref="J00388"><he>יְלֵיף</he></cite>).—

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:2">Cant. R. to II, 2</cite> <he>צבי רבי דייליף</he> would you like to study? <cite ref="Bava Batra 111b:1">B. Bath. 111ᵇ</cite> top <he>גוד לית דין צבי למילף</he> take me away from here, this man has no desire to learn (but only to argue).
<cite ref="Taanit 4a">Taan. 4ᵃ</cite> man is bound <he>למֵילַף נפשיה בניחותא</he> [prob. <he>למַלֵּיף</he>, v. infra] to train himself to be gentle; a. fr.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 18:35">Targ. Ps. XVIII, 35</cite> <cite ref="M01562"><he>מַלֵּיף</he></cite> (= <he>מְאַלֵּף</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 11:25">Targ. Prov. XI, 25</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:10">Koh. R. to IX, 10</cite> thou didst emigrate <he>למילף</he> for the sake of studying, <he>והוא גלי לאַלָּפָא</he> but he emigrated for the sake of teaching. Y. Dem. I, 22ᵃ top <he>ולא כן אַלְּפָן רבי</he> (not <he>איל׳</he>) did you not teach us thus?—<he>א׳ זכו</he>, v. infra.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30">Lev. R. s. 30</cite> (<cite ref="M01562"><he>מַלֵּיף</he></cite>) <he>מוֹלִיף עלי זכו</he> offers arguments in my favor.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 2:4">Targ. Is. II, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 26:9">XXVI, 9</cite>.
